channel.title: GnuTLS Project — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by GnuTLS Project (gnutls).

item.title: CVE-2026-127231 · 5.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — gnutls: double free in X.509 name constraints deinitialization after failed memory allocation
item.description: A double free in the X.509 name constraints enforcement of GnuTLS 3.8.13 on all platforms allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service (application crash) via a certificate chain containing a NameConstraints extension processed while the app…

item.title: CVE-2026-127040 · 5.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — gnutls: denial of service via memory allocation failure in RSA-PSK ClientKeyExchange
item.description: The RSA-PSK ClientKeyExchange handler in gnutls before 3.8.14 does not return after detecting a memory allocation failure when copying the PSK username, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service for a peer under heap pressure.

item.title: CVE-2026-127039 · 5.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — gnutls: denial of service via certificate authentication info reallocation failure
